Loading and material

Torque, speed and load mixture are linked: selecting any one updates the other two. T and P are the two documented operating references. Their mixture combines force and centrifugal-load components; it is not the percentage of time spent at each condition.

Decision criteria

The 5%, 10% and 15% options are the retained decision-sensitivity assumptions, not experimentally established uncertainty bounds. The registered 10% P95 criterion does not guarantee 10% error for an individual prediction.

Loads, constraints and evidence limits

The bore translations are fixed in the research model. The mating gear and physical contact-load sharing are not resolved. Each selected layout uses a screening mesh; the separate four-geometry refinement study does not establish convergence of this exact layout’s absolute capacity.

The two anchor-field figures above are recovered from this case’s byte-authenticated raw arrays. Other tooth positions and full histories are identified in the archived field manifest. These are retained reference solutions, not a new solve of the user’s gear. Sampled DXF profiles contain no manufacturing tolerances, fit specification or production-release authority.

3. Assess carbon for this same geometry

The retained route equation is evaluated using the selected opening area and perimeter. Inputs below define a new planning scenario. Milling uses the retained geometry-specific roughing and finishing recipe. The recommended tools, applied operations and electricity breakdown are shown below.

Machine, cutter and wire-EDM inputs

System boundary and fixed reference inputs

The comparison starts from the same steel blank. It includes modeled opening manufacture, allocated chip pressing and scrap transport, plus the declared mass-related road-fuel saving. Tool production, maintenance, machine manufacture, lubricant, treatment effects, end-of-life credits and replacement effects are not fully inventoried. EDM water input is an inventory quantity, not a water-footprint impact score. Add a separate burden above to test omitted terms.

This is a conditional climate comparison. Product LCA conformity, EPD status, water footprint and production process capability are not established. Road distance is not a prediction of component fatigue life.
